svg.title: tag · trim 100 × 55 mm · bleed 3 mm · safety 8 mm
svg.desc: Drawn at true size: one user unit is one millimetre. The artwork sits inside the trim rectangle; the Bleeding, Cutting and Safety layers can be deleted before printing.
